stem: What is a PRIMARY reason why Hurricane Katrina caused major destruction to New Orleans in 2005?

options.label: F
options.text: Levees surrounding the city collapsed under pressure from floodwaters.

options.label: G
options.text: Crude oil from offshore drilling platforms sparked fires across the city.

options.label: H
options.text: Citywide pavement prevented floodwaters from soaking into the ground.

options.label: J
options.text: Mass evacuations left the city without enough volunteers to build a seawall.
